races.verdict: Mel Rowley has her string in good nick so the returning JUST IN A BIT is fancied to capitalise on a handy-looking mark (form of his final start at Chepstow has been well advertised) and gain a first win. Moonlightinthepark is feared most on the back of a good recent Worcester second, although both Twist Of Fatecatch and Billy Boi Blue can also play a prominent role.
